rateLimits.handlingOn429: Graceful fallback to local UI/UX Pro Max and Impeccable

antiStyleLockingPolicy.lockingPermitted: Post-Stage 4 Concept Approval Gate ONLY upon explicit human sign-off

verifiedTools.name: getStyles
verifiedTools.description: Discover and list available design theme slugs from NeedMCP library.

verifiedTools.name: getStyle
verifiedTools.description: Retrieve color palette, font pairings, border radii, and token definitions for a specific theme slug.

verifiedTools.name: getDesignSystem
verifiedTools.description: Retrieve structural design system rules, spacing scale, elevation profiles, and layout tokens.

verifiedTools.name: getComponents
verifiedTools.description: Retrieve structural component specifications and atomic layout recipes.

verifiedTools.name: selectStyle
verifiedTools.description: Lock the active session to a single selected theme slug. Strictly prohibited prior to human approval.

verifiedTools.name: sendFeedback
verifiedTools.description: Submit user feedback or issue report to NeedMCP service.

degradationPolicy.tier1_authenticated: NeedMCP theme data acts as secondary external reference; UI/UX Pro Max and Impeccable provide primary domain tokens; FigCraft renders native canvas nodes.
degradationPolicy.tier2_rate_limited: Pause remote queries; immediately switch to local Archetypes and UI/UX Pro Max palettes without interrupting design flow.
degradationPolicy.tier3_offline_or_unauthenticated: Zero network calls made. Full Mode and Core Mode continue using local design intelligence with 100% feature availability.

securityGuardrails.zeroSecrets: Never commit API keys or auth headers to git repository.
securityGuardrails.zeroAssetVendoring: Never store proprietary NeedMCP CSS, token bundles, or components in repository source tree.
securityGuardrails.zeroPiiTransmission: Never pass user requirements, proprietary domain data, or PII into NeedMCP query arguments.
securityGuardrails.coreModeIndependence: Core Mode and offline test suites never invoke NeedMCP or require external network access.
